cohort: 310 women with one previous caesarean section who were induced by first-line balloon catheter induction
finding: The vaginal delivery rate after balloon catheter induction in women with a previous caesarean section was 62%, with previous vaginal delivery, initial Bishop score, and evolution of the Bishop score after induction being positive prognostic factors.
mod_finding: The vaginal delivery rate after balloon catheter induction in women with a previous caesarean section was 62%.
